scope: Only codex-review-sol candidate overlay; Pro original mocks/output/reports and initial receiving findings preserved. No other 15-page implementation changes.
relativeBase: Entry base points to ../../finished-mocks/20-search-browse/ for unchanged CSS/assets and batch runtime; script points back to complete candidate/app.js. Original batch directory must remain present.
changes: Input value and clear visibility use S.query directly, independent of empty/results presentation.
Search rerender helper preserves selection start/end/direction and field focus only when that field was focused (or native-like Clear explicitly requests focus).
Pending debounce preserves intentionally focused existing result/control identity when still present and does not steal focus back from outside controls.
Clear cancels pending debounce and preserves cleared field focus.
Enter cancels debounce, renders matching results with appropriate fixture focus/caret and invokes the existing local top item-open action; no match emits no intent.
Initial inline-browse fixture explicitly clears query instead of relying on rendering to hide stored text.
Non-input focus identity includes aria-label in addition to action/value, so desktop Minimize/Fullscreen/Close do not collide.

nativeEnterEvidence.behavior: Return/Enter stops debounce, searches, commits current query and opens top result.
Return/Enter stops debounce, searches and commits; local/no-provider route opens top. searchProvider may own activation.

focusBoundary: Retaining field focus after Enter is fixture-only because item-open stops at a status/intention boundary. Native title activation may navigate or hide Search; never force focus back into Search after real navigation. No native changes are proposed.
